meta.title: BALI MODERN: The Art of Tropical Living
meta.author: Gianni Francione (text) & Luca Invernizzi Tettoni (photography)

parts.title: The New Bali Style: A Blend of Tradition and Modernity

sentences: The **New Bali Style** is about combining local and international influences in architecture.
Tracing its roots to Bali's unique **culture** and **landscape**, this style blends **Western comfort** with **Balinese tradition**.
It's not just design—it's a reflection of the **island's** spiritual **heritage**, harmonizing human and environmental elements.
Emerging from Hindu-Buddhist and **animist** traditions, Bali's architecture thrives on the balance of **microcosm** and **macrocosm**.
As tourism grew, Bali evolved, blending old with new—a charming mix of **traditional** elements and modern living.

parts.title: Bali Architecture: A Fusion of Worlds

sentences: The article introduces **Bali's evolving** architectural landscape influenced by **contemporary and traditional** elements.
**Modern materials** like ceramics, stone, and glass are replacing the **classic Balinese** woods and bamboos, yet **fusion designs** balance both **Western** and **local** aesthetics.
One standout example is a villa in Ubud designed by two **Australian artists** showcasing minimalist **geometric volumes** and vibrant interiors crafted by the owners with **artistic ceramic tiles**.
Their work encapsulates a colorful blend of objects that radiate the region's **tropical joie de vivre.**
**The Conical House** is a villa located on a **hilltop in Canggu**, boasting amazing **ricefield views**.
Designed by a **French architect**, it features a **linear form** with **conical elements** based on West Timor architecture, specifically the **lopo**.
The modern design integrates these **traditional round volumes** in a **residential setting**, creating a harmonious blend between **vernacular forms** and a **contemporary context**.
A **covered walkway** flanked by a **lotus pond** and colorful **frangipani and bougainvillea** welcomes guests into the villa's **interior room**.
The architecture uses **wood, alang-alang**, and **local stones** like ivory marble and sandstone, providing an **impressive yet intimate** atmosphere with well-planned geometries and proportions.

The villa's **pool features** a mosaic tile layout that creates a **crystal blue water effect**, accentuated by **natural sand-colored stone** and **lush gardens**, offering an **inviting, cool, and clean ambiance**.
A **wooden foot-bridge** across a water garden leads to the villa entrance, enhancing its **charm and tranquility**.

parts.title: Shingle Wings: A Grand Design Amidst Nature

paragraphs.heading: Shingle Wings: A Tropical Butterfly
sentences: The **house** in the vibrant **Seminyak area** features a unique **butterfly-wing roof** designed by GM Architects in 1997.
These **wings** frame a central area with bedrooms and kitchen, the walls clad in **ivory limestone**.
Below each **wing**, the **living** and **dining areas** provide a serene view of the **lush surrounding garden**, blending **indoor and outdoor spaces** seamlessly.
The entrances open up with **a triangular glass** feature above, offering a rare **sky-view** from inside, enhancing the harmonious blend of architecture and nature.
The **villa** sits gracefully amidst **tall palms** and a clear **water feature**, creating a bright, airy ambiance.
Notably, the **open-to-the-garden bathroom** shadows under an **ancient tree**, promoting a feeling of being one with nature.
The use of different materials, like **Bengkerai wood** for the roof and flooring, contrasts with outdoor **white pebbles**, adding a natural, yet modern touch to the architectural design.

parts.title: Unique Balinese Designs Highlighted by Luxury and Mystical Elements

sentences: **Octagonal Opulence**

In this **unique villa**, rich in **symbolism** and **strange shapes**, extensive use of **terrazzo** blends with materials like **bleached tropical wood**, **mother-of-pearl inlay**, and **stained glass** for a creative effect.
Located 100 meters from the **beach** in the **Petitenggett area**, this house designed by a fashion designer, incorporates **feng-shui** principles and other **mystical elements**.
The **entrance** has a traditional **Balinese portal** as an **aling aling** to protect against bad spirits.
The villa's design features **two octagonal structures**, with **high-quality terrazzo** used throughout **indoors** for **floors, walls**, and **furnishings**.
**Challenging Nature**
Nestled in the **Sayan Ridge** valley, the **Four Seasons Resort Bali at Sayan** combines modern architecture with the tropical environment.
Designed by John Heah and Co, it features **twenty-eight private villas** that blend with their surroundings using **natural materials** like **ivory-tone cladding**.
The **main structure** includes a **lobby**, **restaurant**, and **18 suites** accessible by a **dramatic footbridge** over 65 feet high, leading to a **large lotus pond**.
A **rich interplay** of architecture is seen **throughout** the property, characterized by a **mixture** of **galleries, bridges**, and **walkways**.

parts.title: The Majestic Pool and Terrace Walkway

sentences: ## **The Majestic Pool and Terrace Walkway**
The **majestic pool** is enclosed by a composition of stone walls, creating a natural, earthy vibe contrasted with a charming **alang-alang grass roof**.
The view from the terrace walkway above the pool offers a **spectacular landscape** to admire.
The space is adorned with **primitive artifacts**, adding an artistic touch to the surroundings.
Natural shadows accentuate the clean, columned walkway.
This setting perfectly complements the **tropical living** theme by harmonizing with the **indigenous nature** while achieving an atmosphere of **relaxation and elegance**.

paragraphs.heading: Bali’s Beautiful Landscapes
sentences: The **bale** in Bali traditionally represents simplicity and beauty.
Originally used in villages for **meetings and ceremonies**, bales decided to **evolve** over time.
Nowadays, bales **adorn** luxurious **resorts**, offering an array of functionalities from relaxing **loungers** to unique **dining pavilions**.
Modern elements like **stone** and **metal** now **complement** this classic Balinese architecture, giving them a **modern twist** while still encapsulating the essence of **Balinese culture**.

paragraphs.heading: Modern Aesthetics
sentences: Designers are incorporating innovative aesthetics; imagine **thatched roofs** and **awnings** over modern materials like **ivory stone** and **wicker**.
These bales are strategically positioned by **pools** or **lily ponds**, creating serene **oases** for guests to savor the tranquility of lush natural beauty.
A standout feature is the use of **traditional granary designs** fused with contemporary concepts, inducing an atmosphere of **tropical luxury**.

paragraphs.heading: Tropical Water Features & Architectural Harmony
sentences: **Balinese** cultures hold **water** as a vital element of life.
Contemporary and traditional **architecture** integrates water to create **serenity** and **aesthetic** appeal.
In **Estate Begawan**, natural **springs** play an integral part by filling pools and even bathroom facilities, creating a **continuous** chain of **refreshment** across the compound.
Such springs are sacred, used in **Hindu** rituals, providing both **nourishment** and inspiring design.
The **Umabona** villa offers a **breathtaking view** from its master bedroom, where a **two-tiered pool** connects with the surrounding **jungle** and offers **spectacular** sunsets.
Another innovative example is the **Lotus Pond**, which serves as the rooftop of the main complex, offering both a **playful** feature and a **meditative** charm.
**Through** these architectural styles, water becomes an **element of beauty**, **functionality**, and spiritual **significance.**
